hypothesis: Explicit partial POSITIVE/NEGATIVE supervision with UNCLEAR cells masked from loss improves Product-18 short-Event classification.

datasetDesign.intendedUnclearDefinition: Every Product-18 cell not explicitly designated POSITIVE or NEGATIVE in the hidden generation specification.
datasetDesign.rationale: Seven positive and nine explicit-negative trials per label are the smallest balanced pool judged sufficient to test broad cell-level coverage while retaining 18 coherent pair trials and 18 low-signal controls. Counts derive only from supervision coverage needs.

cellConsensus.UNCERTAIN: All remaining cases, including every direct POSITIVE versus NEGATIVE conflict

inclusionPolicyDecision: After outputs are frozen, choose HIGH_ONLY if it independently meets every per-label polarity minimum and pair/zero-positive coverage gate; otherwise choose HIGH_PLUS_MEDIUM_EQUAL_WEIGHT if the combined pool meets every frozen gate. This decision uses training-pool agreement statistics only and is made before training.

trainingIfGatePasses.loss: elementwise Product-18 BCEWithLogitsLoss multiplied by the frozen supervision mask, normalized by included cell weights; UNCERTAIN cells have weight zero

evaluationBoundary: Do not open RTN or COSO per-row evidence until data, consensus, mask, training protocol, and trained checkpoint are frozen.
